subject: Does DWLS use polychoric correlations as input

messages.author: 181e1e7e113c0a57
messages.subject: Does DWLS use polychoric correlations as input
parts:
Hello, I was unsure and wanted to check if the default DWLS option that lavaan uses for categorical/ordinal data uses the polychoric correlation matrix as input (as done in the ordinal approahces used by LISREL) or covariance matrix. If lavaan does not sue the polychoric correlation matrix as input, is there a way to request this for ordered categorical data  in a cfa. My understanding is that using the polychoric correlation input matrix is generally recommended for ordinal data. Many thanks
 
Peter

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Does DWLS use polychoric correlations as input
parts:
On 04/07/2014 09:37 AM, f1r3t...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello, I was unsure and wanted to check if the default DWLS option that
> lavaan uses for categorical/ordinal data uses the polychoric correlation
> matrix as input (as done in the ordinal approahces used by LISREL)

Yes. The default estimator (DWLS) computes the thresholds and polychoric
correlations, and follows the approach as described by Muthen (1984).

Yves.
